content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> * Sing Sing Theater, a 1930s Shanghai-themed nightclub in Bangkok's Sukhumvit district, offers a cinematic, theatrical, and upscale late-night experience designed by Ashley Sutton. It features intricate ironwork, paper lanterns, and aerial silk performers, catering to a sophisticated crowd enjoying vocal and deep house music.
> * AGS provides priority reservations, skip-the-line access, and luxury SUV transfers for Sing Sing Theater, ensuring a seamless experience for clients. Advance booking is strictly required for this year-round venue, which has a smart casual dress code.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Step into an impossibly detailed, cinematic 1930s Shanghai speakeasy concept. It is Bangkok's most visually stunning and conceptually ambitious nightclub.

## The Operator & Origin Story
Designed by the legendary Ashley Sutton, Sing Sing Theater represents the peak of themed nightlife. It eschews the standard giant-box club design for intricate ironwork, paper lanterns, hidden staircases, and balconies.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Arrive late to secure a premium booth on the mezzanine level overlooking the main dance floor. The club operates on pure theatre—you will see performers cascading down from aerial silks or engaging in choreographed fan dances. 

The crowd is highly sophisticated, sipping premium bottle service to a soundtrack of vocal and deep house.

## Bangkok’s Most Theatrical Late-Night 19th Hole in Sukhumvit
Situated on Sukhumvit Soi 45 (between Phrom Phong and Thonglor)—just 15 minutes from [Sindhorn Kempinski Hotel Bangkok](/accommodations/thailand/sindhorn-kempinski/) and 5 minutes from [Sorn](/destinations/thailand/thailand-culinary-sorn-southern-fine-dining/) and [Tichuca Rooftop Bar](/destinations/thailand/thailand-nightlife-tichuca-rooftop-bangkok/)—Ashley Sutton’s **Sing Sing Theater** is the undisputed centerpiece for a high-glamour celebration night during [Bangkok & Hua Hin](/tours/the-bangkok-and-hua-hin-fairways/) or [Thailand Ultimate Golf](/tours/thailand-royal-siam/). When your golf group has completed 18 holes at [Thai Country Club](/courses/thailand/thai-country-club/), [Alpine Golf Club](/courses/thailand/alpine-golf-club/), or [Ballyshear Golf Links](/courses/thailand/ballyshear/), rested in the afternoon, and finished a long dinner in Sukhumvit, stepping through Sing Sing’s wrought-iron dragon doors at 10:00 PM plunges your party into a cinematic 1930s Far Eastern cabaret.

## Mezzanine Balcony Booths, Stage Choreography & Dress Code
* **Reserved Upper Mezzanine or Stage-Edge Tables:** Because general-admission guests stand around the perimeter bars once the main stage performance starts at 10:30 PM, Asia Golf Specialists pre-reserves a private mezzanine balcony booth or central banquette with dedicated bottle service so your fourball or 12-player group commands the best sightline in the house.
* **Strictly Enforced Smart-Glamorous Dress Code:** Sing Sing turns away guests in shorts, sandals, flip-flops, or athletic wear at the velvet rope; gentlemen should wear collared button-down shirts or smart dark polos, long trousers, and closed-toe leather shoes.
* **Standby Luxury Private Touring Vehicle Pickup:** At 1:00 AM or whenever your group wraps up, your chauffeur pulls straight up to the Sukhumvit Soi 45 entrance for an effortless return to [Sindhorn Kempinski](/accommodations/thailand/sindhorn-kempinski/).

## Scheduling Sing Sing Theater Around Your Bangkok Tee Sheet
To ensure your fourballs play their best golf on the fast greens of [Ballyshear Golf Links](/courses/thailand/ballyshear/), [Thai Country Club](/courses/thailand/thai-country-club/), and [Alpine Golf Club](/courses/thailand/alpine-golf-club/), we recommend booking your VIP mezzanine booth at Sing Sing Theater either on the night before a scheduled afternoon rest day at [Sindhorn Kempinski Hotel Bangkok](/accommodations/thailand/sindhorn-kempinski/) or ahead of an 11:30 AM late-morning tee time at all-inclusive [Nikanti Golf Club](/courses/thailand/nikanti/) or floodlit [Bangkok Golf Club](/courses/thailand/bangkok-golf-club/). For private groups of eight to sixteen golfers celebrating a final tournament round, our concierge coordinates dedicated table hosts, custom spirit bottle packages, and synchronized multi-van return transfers to your hotel.

faqs.q: What is the dress code for golfers visiting Sing Sing Theater in Bangkok?
faqs.a: Sing Sing Theater strictly enforces an upscale dress code: men must wear long trousers, collared shirts, and closed-toe shoes (golf shorts, flip-flops, sandals, and athletic singlets are refused entry).

faqs.q: What time do the main stage performances and DJ sets peak at Sing Sing Theater?
faqs.a: Doors open at 9:00 PM for craft cocktails, with the signature aerial silk, fan-dance, and live theatrical performances kicking off between 10:15 PM and midnight alongside international house DJs.

faqs.q: Can we pair pre-dinner drinks at Tichuca Rooftop with a late night at Sing Sing Theater?
faqs.a: Yes. Tichuca Rooftop Bar (Sukhumvit Soi 40) and Sing Sing Theater (Sukhumvit Soi 45) sit less than 5 minutes apart in the Phrom Phong / Thonglor corridor, making them Bangkok's premier two-stop nightlife pairing.
